defect: whole-book draws were invalidated by any shared-wallet capacity refusal while all 10000 draws were required valid; complete WF3 primaries gave H1 38, H2 0, H3 2407, H4 1269 valid base books of 10000

rule.draw: unchanged whole-book draw: one template per complete primary episode (symbol, side, holding bars, risk fraction), entries uniform without replacement inside the book, routed through the unchanged shared wallet and costs
rule.acceptance: a draw is valid only if the shared book admits every template and every admitted episode is COMPLETE
rule.resample: ONLY classified refusal reasons are resampled (refusal_groups): draw d tries attempt a = 0, 1, ... until the first valid book
rule.seed_attempt_0: the frozen addendum seed sha256(candidate_id|hypothesis|split|book_index) first 64 bits
rule.per_stress: each stress resamples independently with the same deterministic proposal seed sequence; stress rows are conditionally sampled and NOT paired outcome-by-outcome
rule.fail_closed: any data or episode incompleteness (PR.Incomplete -> data.<reason>, orchestration failure -> data.orchestration, cost failure -> data.cost, an admitted episode not COMPLETE -> episode.incomplete) is never resampled; nor is any refusal reason outside refusal_groups (unclassified.refusal, including capacity.unknown): the stress stops at once and is INCOMPLETE with failed={draw, attempt, reason}

budget.exhaustion: the first draw that exhausts the deterministic budget stops that stress; the stress and the B0 row are INCOMPLETE with exhausted={draw, attempts}

rejection_reasons.resampled: see refusal_groups; rejection_reasons keys are the sorted '+'-joined refusal set of each rejected attempt
rejection_reasons.fail_closed: data.<incomplete reason>, data.orchestration: <msg>, data.cost: <msg>, episode.incomplete, unclassified.refusal: <reasons>; never resampled

chosen_without: any candidate or B0 P&L; the only result-derived inputs seen were the valid-book counts in the defect line
compatibility: when attempt 0 is valid for every draw the outputs equal the pre-amendment generator (golden-digest test)

refusal_groups.unclassified: fail closed: the stress stops INCOMPLETE with reason unclassified.refusal: <reasons>

conditioning: The rule is NOT P&L-independent. Resampling PATH_DEPENDENT refusals conditions the null on avoiding drawdown halts (risk.daily_loss depends on earlier legs' marks) and size refusals (execution.size_min depends on the wallet path). This is a conservative upward selection: it biases mean B0 P&L UP and makes the null harder to beat. STRUCTURAL refusals depend only on proposed entry times, symbols and holding periods.

interpretation.metric: path_dependent_share = path_dependent_refusals / total_resampled_refusals (0 when the denominator is 0), counted over individual refused rows per stress x hypothesis

labels.MATERIAL_CONDITIONING: share >= 0.05; the B0 p-value cannot be used as clean-null promotion evidence
